Website editor

Checking the editor configuration…

Connect your GitHub repository to finish setting up this editor:

  1. Sign in to Decap Turbo and connect your website repository.
  2. Create a Turbo site using branch main and config path admin/config.yml. Add this page's address as its admin interface URL.
  3. Copy the Site ID from Turbo into turbo_site_id in your repository's admin/config.yml.
  4. Commit the change, wait for GitHub Pages to finish deploying, then reload this page.

The repository includes detailed instructions in DECAP_SETUP.md. The Site ID is a public identifier; do not put passwords or API tokens in the configuration.
